Supreme Court of the United States

Conference of September 27, 2021

1305 cases distributed for this conference — sortable and filterable. Sort by Relists to surface the serially-relisted cases; the darkest Grant forecast cells are the likeliest grants.

Grant forecast leads with the model’s estimate that this petition is granted at any conference, now or after further relists, and is shaded by that value. Beneath it, here is the estimate that it is granted at this conference and GVR the companion estimate of a grant, vacate & remand at this one. The leading number and here differ most for a petition at its first conference, which is usually relisted or denied rather than granted on the spot. Paid petitions only. Estimates, not predictions about any case.
